headline: CNN reports 11 killed, ~50 injured in Russian counter-strikes incl. Odesa energy
dek: 11 killed, nearly 50 injured across Ukraine in Russian missile/drone attacks in 24h to Sunday morning, incl. 'massive attack on energy facilities' in Odesa.
sources: CNN; Zelensky X posts; St Petersburg governor; US government
fault_line: Is the diesel deal pragmatism that ends the war — or cash that funds Russia's strikes?

sections.what_happened: 11 killed, nearly 50 injured across Ukraine in Russian missile/drone attacks in 24h to Sunday morning, incl. 'massive attack on energy facilities' in Odesa. Zelensky: Russia has hit Ukraine's energy and oil-gas sectors 76 times since Trump announced the energy ceasefire a week ago. Starlink curbs on Ukrainian battlefield drones continue (Trump admin denies restriction). Trump waived sanctions on Russian diesel imports and Friday invoked a waiver exempting Russia from sweeping economic penalties mandated by Congress. St Petersburg governor: 1 killed, 5 injured in Ukrainian drone attack; Finland imposed flight curbs during the attack.
sections.what_verified: Casualty and strike data from Ukrainian authorities via CNN; diesel waiver consistent with 0500-01 EO item and playbook tier-1 diesel-deal demand; St Petersburg figures consistent with earlier coverage.
sections.what_disputed: Trump administration denies restricting Starlink service; Russian MoD claims 200+ Ukrainian drones downed and major battlefield gains (unverified).
sections.context: Background: Russia/Ukraine — UPDATE (extends 1100-02/1400-05): CNN reports 11 killed, ~50 injured in Russian counter-strikes incl. Odesa energy; Trump diesel waiver detail

totw_analysis: Our read: The fault line our audience is arguing over: Is the diesel deal pragmatism that ends the war — or cash that funds Russia's strikes?
